checks: The exact source hash matches cb7ea417552f0084. Its Introduction and §§1–4 supply the same radial hypotheses, active-hinge formula, centroid gauge and equality criterion. The accepted retained-cap result replaces the source’s pending static citation.

For each small parameter the inner homothet retains a fixed-radius ball about the moving mark. The radial shell has Jacobian H(x)(1-s)^(d−1) by tangent scaling and the normal component of the radial derivative. Distinct old endpoints give distinct rays. In d=1 the area formula is two ordinary interval substitutions. The thickness bound gives nonnegative speed and L1 convergence of Ht/ε by domination.

Replacing the shell weight by the old hinge, and the radial factor by one, incurs O(ε²) uniformly for u in a compact set. At a supporting facet where the hinge is zero the shell height is O(ε); this covers facet coincidences and lower-dimensional incidences without a moving-section derivative.

On the fixed body the mark gradient is −|D_u(y)|u. The zero level is volume-null for u≠0 and there is strict positivity near u=0, yielding joint continuity and the compact-uniform mark expansion. A fixed centered inner ball makes G_ε coercive uniformly, so actual minimizers lie in one compact ball and all cluster points are old minimizers. The upper bound evaluates at an old minimizer of the linear response and the lower bound drops G_0(u_ε)−min G_0≥0. The old cap has mass T on the entire optimizer set.

At the centroid the affine integral equals V. Negativity anywhere would extend to positive volume, hence the optimizer set is the whole negative polar. Substituting q=−u and using the polar support identity gives −D−p_{K−y}(−B−Vw). Constant and coordinate weights give the centroid velocity −B/V, and boundedness of K−y makes the gauge zero exactly at the zero vector.

Independently checked the sign on the asymmetric triangle with vertices (0,0),(3,0),(0,3) and fixed body, old centroid (1,1) and w=(−1,−1). The homothetic retained cap has volume (9/2)(1−ε)^2 and derivative −9, agreeing with the gauge at −Vw=(9/2,9/2). Also checked a moving noncentroid interval by exact rational tail lengths. The archived supplementary script separately reproduced 2442 exact checks.
